value.answer: Mostly overrated, I'd say. It's well made, third-party tested, and most people find it tastes decent. But several blends are underdosed, there's no independent clinical evidence for its benefit claims, and at about $112 a box one-time (around $89 on subscription) it's one of the pricier all-in-ones out there. It can make sense if it replaces a few other supplements for you. Heads up: doubling up on vitamin A, zinc or niacin can push you past safe upper limits, and reishi or grape seed can interact with blood thinners or blood pressure meds, so check with a doctor or pharmacist first if you take any of that.
